title: 모델 내부 축소·확대를 데이터셋 방식(23탭 보간, MTF 블러 + 솎음)으로 교체
hypothesis: Matching the model-internal resampling to the dataset operators (23-tap interpolation for the MS / LRPAN upsampling, the MTF degradation for the LRPAN, an anti-aliased internal downsampling) improves RR over the same-seed 89 confirmed model (variant N).
plan_context: final-model plan (2026-11-19): 88 K2D -> 89 (W2 2x2, lambda, c) -> 90 (this) -> final model with seeds 43 and 44; single seed 42 per stage, validation selection, test reported only
base_recipe: 89 confirmed: W2 2x2 (convT), 88 K2D (full-size 2x2 C2MS at constant lr 1e-4 for 120 epochs -> 83 K2 factorization -> 30-epoch cosine 1e-4 -> 1e-6 with a new Adam), selection by minimum original-scale validation MSE

loss.form: per-pixel L1 + c x per-pixel L1 on 2x coarser pairs + lambda x spectral loss (1 - cos)
loss.source: 89 selection: lambda* 1.2 (selection_A.json), c* 0.25 (selection_B_reduced.json, reduced c range by user decision 2026-11-20)

variants.N: unchanged (bilinear, align_corners=True); the 89 confirmation model and the control of A, B, C
variants.A: upsample1 (x4) and upsample100 (x2) -> 23-tap interpolation (common/interpolation, toolbox phases); performance 6 condition
variants.B: A + downsample1 -> PAN MTF blur (genMTF 41x41 ratio 4, the training sensor PAN GNyq, replicated boundary) + x4 decimation phase 2 (= 54 Wald.pan)
variants.C: every fixed resampling matched to the dataset (user decision 2026-11-20 23h): B + downsample100 (x2; features with the per-band MS MTF, PAN with the PAN MTF, genMTF ratio 2 = the coarse-pair kernels) at phase 0, downsample200 (features x2, MS MTF ratio 2) at phase 1, downsample2 (PAN x4, PAN MTF ratio 4) at phase 2 (data grid: 1/2 pixel k = full 2k, 1/4 pixel j = 4j + 2) + output upsampling upsample101 / upsample102 with the two stages of the dataset 23-tap interpolation (insertion phase 1, then 0)
variants.unchanged: W2 branch 2x2 layers (learned), data / coarse pairs / projection operators

arms: <v>T = full-size 2x2 trunk 120 epochs (snapshot e120), <v>K = K2 from <v>T e120, 30-epoch cosine; v in N, A, B, C; QB, GF2, WV3 seed 42 (24 trainings)
order: N of GF2, QB, WV3 first (the 89 confirmation), then A, B, C; factorized runs and evaluations first when ready; two jobs at once

selection_rule.metric: validation PSNR of <v>K (minimum original-scale validation MSE, network output without projection) minus that of NK, same sensor and seed
selection_rule.choice: variant (A, B, C) with the largest mean of the three sensor differences; it is chosen only if that mean is > 0 and on no sensor the validation SAM is worse than NK by more than tau_s; otherwise the next variant by the mean; if none qualifies the model stays N
selection_rule.tau_basis: as 89: 2 x sample std of the 65 seeds 42-44 best-epoch validation SAM
selection_rule.test: RR test (with projection) against NK, 88 K2D and C2MS-SP is measured and reported only; never used for the choice

confirmation_89.model: NK (N variant) = the 89 confirmation (lambda* 1.2, c* 0.25, W2 2x2, K2D 150 epochs), trained here because it is also the 90 control
confirmation_89.judgement: v2.4 RR test PSNR/SAM/ERGAS, single-seed threshold 0.06 dB (report); WV2 transfer and FR QNR reference

evaluation: each <v>K: best.pt on the 20 RR test scenes without and with the 86 K10 projection, FR QNR (+P, reference); WV3 also on WV2 (82 calibration, reference); controls C2MS-SP and 88 K2D cached in optimize
stop_rule: as 89 without the PSNR margin (user decision 2026-11-19 14h): process error, incomplete run, nonfinite validation or best epoch 0 -> no new job, running jobs finish, stopped.json, exit 3
chain: chain90.ps1: wait for the 89 reduced stage B (fine_c_complete.json) and continue only if c* = 0.25 -> server tidy-up (empty folders) -> copy the 89 source tree and overlay the 90 folder -> prepare -> optimize -> run

expected_gpu_hours.definition: sum of run wall times / 2 (two concurrent runs); 88/89 concurrent epoch times QB 134 s, GF2 156 s, WV3 98 s

limits: single seed 42; the 3-seed judgement is done once on the final model
the variant is chosen on validation only; test differences of 0.06 dB or less are within the single-seed threshold
B and C use the MTF of the training sensor; on the WV2 transfer the WV3 kernels stay
C changes the internal downsampling and the output upsampling together (a fully matched model); if C is chosen the two parts are not separated
the 1/4-size features are made by two x2 MTF steps (an SSAI update in between), close to but not equal to the dataset x4 MTF
precision: FP16 AMP training with GradScaler; FP32 loss, validation and evaluation; factorization in float32 with float64 accumulation
ema_note: EMA recorded only (as 65); selection uses the online weights

latency.setting: one process, no training on the GPU, batch 1, test scene 0 (RR 256^2, FR 512^2), float32, TF32 off, cuDNN deterministic, autotune off, NCHW; 5 warm-up, 50 timed runs per system interleaved, 3 rounds, median of the round medians
latency.reference: cuDNN autotune + TF32 and FP16 autocast timings and the FP16 RR change (never a judgement)

screening.decision: user 2026-11-21 02h: choose the variant on 50-epoch screening runs as in the 89 lambda search, not on 150-epoch K2D runs
screening.arms: AS, BS, CS = full-size 2x2 C2MS of the variant, 50 epochs (40 at 1e-4 + 10 cosine to 1e-6), lambda 1.2, c 0.25; GF2, QB, WV3 seed 42; validation only
screening.n_control: 89 stage-B run BL1.20C0.25 of the same sensor (identical recipe and seed; separate run, rerun spread up to 0.03 dB)
screening.selection: selection_rule above applied to the screening validation (variant minus the N control)
screening.mechanism: the sealed controller keeps training N (the 89 confirmation); provenance/block_abc.py holds the worker locks of AT/BT/CT so the controller stops at its first A/B/C trunk; run.py --mode screen (separate copy of the tree, same runtime) uses the free slot, then finishes the N jobs the controller left (factorize + NK + evaluation) and the screening runs
screening.next: final model: the chosen variant with the K2D 150-epoch recipe, seeds 42, 43, 44 (if N: seeds 43, 44; seed 42 is the 89 confirmation)
